newsitem.title: JAPAN: Some Japan bank shares climb on foreign buying.
newsitem.headline: Some Japan bank shares climb on foreign buying.

text.p: Shares in some major Japanese banks rose on Tuesday afternoon, as some foreign investors bought the shares, which were oversold in the recent slide, brokers said.
The share price of Daiwa Bank Ltd jumped 34 yen to 646 yen by 0503 GMT. Volume was 3.951 million shares.
Sumitomo Bank Ltd gained 70 yen to 1,860 yen after it briefly falling to 1,770 yen. Volume was 2.257 million shares.
Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd gained 60 yen to 1,780 yen, on turnover of 2.1 million shares.
